hypothesis: The action-side Manny neutral/bind-axis composition is not symmetric with the observation-side Manny-bind-to-canonical-SMPL recovery, so an absolute ProtoMotions joint target does not round-trip through the two adapters as the same canonical joint rotation before constraint-range adaptation.
supporting_runtime_evidence_before_exper: E14 established exact agreement between the checkpoint's 69 conditioned actions and the pinned ProtoMotions v2.3 decoder while RealOnnxPolicy still failed body linear speed, pelvis height, and root tilt.
E3 established exact target publication/readback and showed a distinct Manny neutral/bind composition stage before protective range adaptation.
E13 showed that bypassing constraint-range mapping worsened the locked result, focusing the next semantic check upstream of that protective stage.
The controlled-target plant has stood under the same fully simulated topology.
competing_explanations: The action and observation transforms are symmetric for all one-to-one mapped joints and the captured activation neutral correctly represents ProtoMotions identity.
The adapters are symmetric but an upstream root, heading, future-pose, velocity, or other observation semantic is wrong.
The full semantic contract is correct and this checkpoint/reference state lacks a standing solution for the current initial condition.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: The trace-on arm remains behaviorally identical to baseline, but at least one decisive one-to-one joint exceeds 0.001 degrees for identity, actual decoded, or known-axis action-to-observation round trip.
falsification_observation: The trace-on arm is behaviorally identical to baseline and all 19 decisive one-to-one joints round-trip identity, the actual decoded target, and all positive/negative XYZ probes within 0.001 degrees with complete finite frame data.

runtime_log_readback.notes: The one-warning count difference is outside the preregistered neutrality judges and reflects log-rate/timing output; all raw physics, policy, input, action-semantic, render, locked criteria, and behavioral metrics are exact.

baseline.name: trace_disabled
baseline.configuration: Clean runtime commit; reused binary; locked standing-plant v2; RealOnnxPolicy; 1/60 s; 10 s; unchanged seed and initial pose; no perturbation; Manny local-frame trace disabled.

experimental.name: trace_enabled
experimental.configuration: Identical clean commit, reused binary, model, protocol, timestep, window, seed, pose, perturbation, evaluator, and thresholds; only -PhysAnimMannyLocalFrameRoundtripTrace was enabled.

result.conclusion: The live action-side transform is not the inverse of the live observation-side transform before range adaptation. Identity input isolates a policy-neutral-versus-bind offset on all 19 decisive joints. Nonzero targets additionally expose direct use of a world-captured action axis against component-space observation recovery: the component-to-world rotation is 90 degrees in this harness. The cached action and observation bind parent-relative rotations match exactly, and the action axis matches the observation parent bind after explicit world-to-component conversion, so the mismatch is localized to the runtime choice of neutral and frame during action composition rather than missing or corrupt bind calibration.

retention.retained: Development-only round-trip trace, independent evaluator, malformed-artifact tests, frame-ownership tests, operation-order metadata, and raw runtime artifacts.
retention.rejected_behavior_removed: not applicable; E15 introduced no behavior experiment

next_experiment.selection: Test only the action conjugation-axis frame behind a development override: use the cached T-pose parent axis expressed in mesh component space instead of its world-space value, while keeping the captured policy neutral, range mapping, constraints, physics, protocol, and all other variables unchanged.
next_experiment.reason: The 90-degree component-to-world rotation expands actual-target error to 106.602 degrees and known-axis error to 47.155 degrees, while identity input is axis-independent and provides a fixed neutral-offset control.
next_experiment.expected_if_supported: Identity round-trip errors remain byte-for-byte unchanged, while each actual and XYZ-probe round-trip error collapses to that joint's existing identity residual within 0.001 degrees; baseline remains unchanged and the physical verdict is reported without threshold changes.
next_experiment.falsification_observation: The trace confirms component-space axis selection but actual/probe errors do not collapse to the unchanged per-joint identity residuals within tolerance.
next_experiment.promotion: No production promotion until the separate override experiment succeeds; neutral-versus-bind will remain a later one-variable experiment.
